description: High-performance cementitious adhesive with no vertical slip for ceramic and porcelain tiles
whereToUse: Interior and exterior bonding of ceramic tiles, porcelain and mosaics on floors, walls and ceilings.
conventional renders or cementitious mortar on walls
gypsum or anhydrite after having first applied Primer G
cementitious screeds, as long as they are sufficiently cured and dry
interior painted walls, as long as the paint is firmly anchored
Tile on tile of existing flooring with tiles up to 900 cm²
Bonding on irregular floor substrates and renders, without levelling, to a thickness of 15 mm
notFor: on precast and poured concrete walls
on walls or floors subject to extreme flexing or vibration (wood, fibre-cement, etc.)

standards.value: EC1 R PLUS - very low emission

technicalData.label: Mixing ratio
technicalData.value: 100 parts Adesilex P7 with 26-28 parts of water by weight for Adesilex P7

technicalData.label: Bonding strength in compliance with EN 1348 (N/mm2): - initial bonding after 28 days

consumption.basis: Spot-bonding insulation materials - gypsum board panels, foamed concrete
consumption.quote: -Gypsum board panels, foamed concrete: approx. 1.5 kg/m²

mixing: Use 26-28 parts of water for every 100 parts by weight of Adesilex P7, which is equal to 6.5-7.0 L of water for every 25 kg of Adesilex P7.
packaging: Adesilex P7 white and grey are available in 25 kg bags.
storage: Adesilex P7 can be stored 12 months in a normal environment in original packaging.
notes: 1) This is an old edition (61-12-2017). 2) Consumption list layout is ambiguous: the line 'Mosaics and small sizes' is followed by two dashed lines, '-in general (trowel n. 4): 2 kg/m²' and '-normal sizes (trowel n. 5): 2.5-3 kg/m²', so 'normal sizes' is printed as if it were a sub-item of 'Mosaics and small sizes'. The basis text in consumption reflects the most natural reading (small sizes = trowel 4, normal sizes = trowel 5). 3) Pot life: body text says 'approximately 8 hours', the table says 'over 8 hours'. 4) The mixing ratio row in the table reads oddly as printed ('...26-28 parts of water by weight for Adesilex P7'); copied as is. 5) Primer naming differs inside the sheet: 'Primer G' in the application examples, 'Primer G or Ecoprim T' in substrate preparation. 6) The sheet says bonding is possible 'to a thickness of 15 mm' but gives no thickness row in the technical data and no per-mm consumption. 7) The WHERE TO USE paragraph also covers wet areas and spot bonding of insulating materials (expanded polystyrene, rock and glass wool, Eraclit wood-cement panels, sound-deadening panels); that sentence is not in whereToUse because the extraction breaks 'wood-cement' across a line. The application example 'gypsum board' is also not in whereToUse (8-item cap). 8) ANSI A118.4 is listed under 'In compliance with' with no class. VOC is printed as 0 g/l.
